content.title: Implement: agt events list/add commands + type filtering + custom events
content.description: Implement the agreed spec for the `agt events` namespace in the library/CLI: new `events list` command (replaces `history`), `--type` filter, new `events add` command storing custom events, tracker API methods, type definitions, and the reserved-type collision validation. Remove or deprecate the old `history` command per the spec. Add/extend library tests.
